_comment: Mirror of the Dad Coach tools and context providers in the platform catalog (platform Flyway V18, V38, V62, V69, V73 and the weekly_plan_context provider created through the admin API on 2026-09-28 - see TASKS DC-C05 for the migration that makes it reproducible). Every key here has a handler in Dad Coach: tools in api/tools/ToolDispatcher (POST /api/tools/{key}), providers in api/context/ContextProviderRouter (POST /api/context/{key}). The manifest tests keep the YAML and this list in step.
